answer: Require each identity to bind a hardware attestation: a secure enclave signs a crystal-clear proof that the agent runs on one distinct physical device, and the network rate-limits minting to one identity per device per month. A Sybil farmer can no longer clone a thousand agents from one server; each fake needs its own machine, turning forgery into a hardware bill. The signal is verifiable on-chain, and like a nebula collapsing into stars, scattered anonymous compute condenses into accountable, countable devices.
